category.name: Business email hosting
category.description: Custom-domain mailbox servers and groupware; distinguishes email hosting from complete office suites and mail clients.
category.audience: Organizations operating custom-domain employee email, and IT administrators responsible for delivery and mailbox infrastructure.
category.audienceRationale: Custom-domain email serves businesses across functions; self-operated server selection and ongoing delivery operations chiefly concern IT teams. Qualitative audience reach, not a counted market estimate.

pricing.note: Business Starter standard USD $7/user/month with one-year commitment; temporary promotions excluded.
Business Basic without Teams USD $5.40/user/month paid yearly; web/mobile apps. Basic with Teams $7; desktop apps require another plan.

Basic USD 3/user/month billed yearly ($36/user/year); custom domains require at least one Standard or Professional user (Standard USD 5/user/month annually). Basic lacks third-party mail-client access; compare actual account mix.
Mail Lite is paid per user/month, billed annually with no monthly plan. Numeric USD price absent from rendered source; free plan has separate 5-user and protocol limits.

oss.name: mailcow: dockerized
serviceLimitations: Server resources, DNS, backups, upgrades and mail delivery reputation remain operator responsibilities; paid managed hosting/support are optional services.
oss.classificationReason: GPLv3 orchestration and mailcow UI with an integrated mail/groupware stack. Reviewed documentation exposes administration, spam controls, SOGo and mailbox migration without an edition paywall; Servercow sells hosting and support rather than a separate gated software edition. Bundled components retain their own licenses.

health.rsx: Shared authenticated analysis completed; overall score 5.3. Repository health is evidence, not a security guarantee.

oss.name: Stalwart Community
locked: Enterprise license required for deleted-email restoration and account archiving/un-deletion.
Enterprise-only AI/LLM spam classification and Sieve scripting; standard rule/statistical spam filtering remains Community.
Additional enterprise administration includes multi-tenancy, SCIM provisioning, advanced telemetry and sharded/read-replica storage.
serviceLimitations: Future first-party managed service announced with registration of interest; current general availability, regions and numeric SLAs not confirmed. Self-hosted infrastructure and delivery operations still cost money.
oss.classificationReason: Community source is AGPL-3.0-only, with per-file dual licensing and proprietary SEL enterprise sections. C because recovery and AI-assisted mail workflows require Enterprise, beyond administrative extras. Optional first-party managed hosting is announced, not confirmed generally available.

health.rsx: Shared authenticated analysis completed; overall score 6. Repository health is evidence, not a security guarantee.
